product_metadata.title: Bed Maker’s Never Lift Your Mattress Wrap Around Bed Skirt, Classic Style, Low Maintenance Wrinkle Resistant Fabric, Traditional 14 Inch Drop Length, California King, Mocha
features: Easy On, Easy Off: Mattresses can be extremely heavy and awkward to lift. Our revolutionary, patented* design makes putting on and removing your bedskirt a piece of cake. Our unique design can be added to your bed in just seconds.

Stays Put: The sturdy elasticized strips and mitered corners ensure the skirt stays in place without sagging or shifting over time. This innovative bed skirt does not have a traditional fabric platform, so the mattress does not need to be lifted.

Specifications: The California king-size measures 84” x 72” and has a classic 14” drop. The corners are pre-split to accommodate footboards and 4-post beds. Our bed skirt hides box springs, bed frames, and legs you’d rather not be visible.

Tailored Design: The contemporary design features 5 box pleats and 2 split corners, and easily coordinates with existing bedding. The 100% semi-sheer microfiber polyester fabric is machine washable, wrinkle-resistant, colorfast, and pre-shrunk.
Fits Your Bed: The Never Lift Your Mattress Bed Skirt was designed to fit with all standard beds in the corresponding size with a box spring.
description: Everyone loves the finished look a bed skirt gives to your room, but no one loves the hassle of putting one on. The patented* Bed Maker's Never Lift Your Mattress Bed Skirt makes it a breeze to give your bedroom a hotel-quality look without lifting your heavy mattress. The hidden elastic band at the head of your bed slips around your mattress, and the mitered corners at the foot of the bed lock the skirt in place. We’ve also included spiral bed skirt pins for added security and to ensure the best fit with your bed. Our exclusive design is ideal for older adults and single people or those with back problems to use in furnished rental homes, or for anyone who wants to take the stress out of housework. The tailored design is a modern update to the traditional dust ruffle. The clean look works with just about all bed linens from modern comforter sets to traditional quilts and solid or patterned sheets. The classic 14” drop conceals unsightly box springs, platforms, or generic metal bed frames to give your space a pulled together look. Adding a bed skirt also allows you to use the area under your bed as additional storage, which is particularly helpful in smaller homes, dorm rooms, apartments, and vacation homes. Bed Maker’s reduced the size of our packaging to leave less of a carbon footprint. Make your life easier and your room neater with the help of Bed Maker’s. Quick Tip: To remove any wrinkles, place the bed skirt in the dryer for five minutes with a damp washcloth on high heat. *Patent granted on October 27, 2015

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low heat. Remove promptly. Warm iron bed skirt drop as needed. Do not iron platform.
